prompt: Write a concise professional business email announcing a change to the quarterly review schedule to a team. Include at least one list of three or more items and one decision the team will not revisit.
Write a short follow-up email to a client after a meeting, summarizing three action items and asking for confirmation by Friday. Keep it natural and professional.
Write an internal memo about the launch plan for a new product, covering the marketing rollout, the sales enablement and the support ramp. Mention that the deadline is realistic and will not change.
